name: FreeDNS Afraid.org Free
free_limit: Free static and dynamic DNS hosting, subdomains on shared public domains or own domains; Starter tier allows up to 5 subdomains with one-hour TTL.
watch_out: Free Starter has captchas and lacks wildcard DNS, stealth flags and premium propagation. Paid plans offer 50+ subdomains and 60-second TTL. Payment-card and commercial-use terms are not clearly stated on official free-plan pages.
